description: Ten global band powers averaged on Wang and Mengoni 2022 §2.2 geography, mapped onto that paper's own 10-20 zone letters on this 32-channel cap. Wang does not publish these electrode tuples. Derived measures stay on current_v1. Not confirmatory. Cleaning stays full-montage. Hz edges stay Angela/Zheng/Cochran.

provenance.paper: Wang Z, Mengoni P. Brain Inform. 2022;9:11. doi:10.1186/s40708-022-00159-3.
provenance.what_wang_says: §2.2 is location prose: adults frontal δ; left central/parietal/temporal θ; occipital α; frontal and central β; cortex γ, grouped in the introduction with frontal/central alertness. §2.1 maps letters Fp F C P T O and notes P7/P8 are posterior temporal, F7/F8 sit on frontal plus temporal pole. The method then picks zones per patient from clinical-report keywords. Not one fixed five-band electrode list.
provenance.what_this_file_does: Applies those zone words to the recorded 10-20 sites. δ = Fp+F (frontally). θ = left C/P/T, with P7 in T. α = O. β and γ = F+C, not Fp. No FC/CP invented sites. Same Hz edges as current_v1.
provenance.not_used: George and Gulia 2025 nine-site montage (that is literature_roi_v0). Do not mix the two papers into one list.
provenance.angela_does: Band power on every recorded channel; Zheng and Cochran cited only for Hz edges. Those edges stay: δ 0.5–4, θ 4–8, α 8–13, β 13–30, γ 30–40.

cleaning.note: Do not subset channels before notch, average reference, interpolation, or ICA.
